KIDSUNITED Is Bringing a New Indoor Kids Activity to Appleton

  • By Sponsored Article
  • June 22, 2026
  • Feature

A new indoor activity for kids is coming to Appleton later this summer.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:57
Instaread

KIDSUNITED Appleton opens August 28, 2026, and will offer soccer-based classes for kids 18 months to 9 years old. The program uses soccer to keep kids active and engaged, but it is much more than a traditional soccer program.

Classes help kids build confidence, coordination, listening skills, teamwork, and a positive first experience with sports.

Families can sign up now for a free class and choose a preferred class time before the August 28, 2026, opening.

What Is KIDSUNITED?

KIDSUNITED is an indoor child development program that uses soccer as the activity.

Kids will kick, run, score goals, and learn soccer fundamentals, but the bigger focus is helping them grow through movement, play, and encouragement.

For younger kids, that means practicing things like listening, taking turns, balance, coordination, and feeling comfortable in a class setting. As kids get older, classes become more technical, soccer-focused, helping them build stronger ball skills, footwork, focus, teamwork, and game understanding.

For kids who already enjoy soccer, KIDSUNITED can be a helpful supplement to seasonal league play. For kids who are brand new to sports, it can be a positive place to start.

Built for Fox Valley Families

Classes run year-round indoors, giving families a consistent activity option through every season, with no need to worry about rainouts.

Classes are high-energy, age-appropriate, and designed around small groups. Each class has two coaches, giving kids more attention, encouragement, and chances to participate.

KIDSUNITED Appleton will be the first KIDSUNITED location in Wisconsin and is locally owned.

Sign Up for a Free Class

The KIDSUNITED Appleton class schedule is now open, and families can sign up for a free class before the August 28 opening. All who attend a class during their grand opening week will receive a discounted membership and special founding-member perks.

Families can learn more and sign up for a free class here: www.kidsunited.com/appleton
